title: Comparing penguin body mass
text:
Average body mass
Calculate the average for each species.

penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=["body_mass_g"])

mean_mass = penguins_clean.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean()
mean_mass

species
Adelie       3700.662252
Chinstrap    3733.088235
Gentoo       5076.016260
Name: body_mass_g, dtype: float64

title: Comparing penguin body mass
text:
Plot
A bar chart to compare the average body mass.

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

mean_mass.plot(kind="bar", rot=0)
plt.xlabel("Species")
plt.ylabel("Average body mass (g)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Average body mass by penguin species.

title: Comparing penguin body mass
text:
Found
Gentoo penguins have the highest average body mass, about 5,076 g. Adelie and Chinstrap penguins have similar averages, about 3,701 g and 3,733 g.
